soundPalette.targetFeeling: Small, familiar father-toddler tenderness; safety and quiet companionship.
soundPalette.texture: Ambience-led first. If music helps, audition a delicate rounded timbre with little low-mid mass.
soundPalette.density: Very sparse; no continuous arpeggio or chord bed by default. Keep room between events.
soundPalette.register: Avoid weighty bass and piercing bright attacks; choose by actual listening, not instrument name.
soundPalette.pulse: Follow hesitant invitation, unhurried sitting and settled gaze; no compulsory BPM or cut accents.
soundPalette.foregroundPriority: The child and father's small physical exchange lead; rain/cloth support; music stays secondary.
soundPalette.silence: Allow music-free opening and action space while plausible sheltered ambience continues.
soundPalette.ending: Let recognition breathe; a restrained decay, not a swelling finale or new musical idea.
soundPalette.comparison: Same locked picture: ambience-only versus a sparse candidate at comfortable levels. Reject heaviness even if peak/LUFS pass.

references.prompt: Photorealistic live-action casting reference for two original fictional Korean characters, not an illustration, collage or film scene. One vertical 9:16 full-body image. Screen-left: Minjun, a clearly TWO-YEAR-OLD Korean toddler boy with a round toddler face, soft short dark hair, natural toddler head-to-body proportions and short little legs, wearing a plain rust-orange knitted sweater, beige trousers and small unbranded shoes. He must look about two, not a school-age child. Screen-right: his father Junho, a handsome Korean man about 33, youthful adult features, neatly styled short black hair, clean-shaven, wearing a plain muted navy shirt with sleeves rolled to his forearms, charcoal trousers and simple unbranded shoes. Natural adult-toddler height difference. Relaxed separate standing poses close enough for a safe family portrait, both faces and complete bodies visible; calm gentle expressions, no exaggerated grin. Original faces, no requested celebrity or real-person likeness. Natural skin texture and believable anatomy. Plain warm-gray seamless background, broad soft OFF-CAMERA daylight and gentle fill, grounded soft contact shadows beneath the feet. No lighting equipment visible, no softbox, bench, coat, rain, glow, extra people, physical embrace, writing, labels, logos or panels. This establishes faces, relative age, scale and wardrobe only; later scenes will be separately staged and lit.
